name: VenHub Global, Inc. Common Stock
summary: VenHub Global, Inc. specializes in providing advanced autonomous retail solutions. The company offers technologically sophisticated smart stores, complemented by a full suite of support services for automated operations. These solutions are deployed as both fixed installations and versatile mobile units, guaranteeing round-the-clock access to products and services without the need for supplementary personnel. Beyond its physical retail presence, VenHub furnishes essential services such as seamless integration with existing systems, continuous operational assistance, routine maintenance, and efficient supplier management for store proprietors. Its proprietary platform incorporates artificial intelligence-powered analytics, enabling clients to optimize their operations and gain valuable insights into customer behaviors. VenHub also cultivates strategic partnerships for brand integration and is committed to community-focused initiatives in areas like education, nutrition, and healthcare. Designed to be modular and highly customizable, its solutions allow businesses to readily expand and adapt to evolving market conditions. The company serves a broad spectrum of industries, including traditional retail, healthcare and pharmaceuticals, government agencies, military operations, sports and entertainment venues, event organizers, and small business owners seeking innovative autonomous retail capabilities. VenHub Global, Inc. was founded in 2024 and operates from Pasadena, California.
